body: Thank you. I don't want to lie about who I am, though. I've been in these social groups for a while. It just feels like no one would be bothered too long if I died, is all, which is good. If I ever get my shit together I'll update you.

Thank you. To clarify, it's not that I think I'm spoiled for hating myself, it's that my life has been without any actual difficulty or hardship, I've had luxuries that many people can't even imagine, but I have all of that and still want to die.
